control_objective: Ensure adjustments above agent authority are approved.
rule_logic: credit_amount > agent_authority_limit requires approved approval_id

control_objective: Prevent over-refunding.
rule_logic: credit_amount <= related total_charge_amount unless executive approval

control_objective: Prevent repeated charges or credits.
rule_logic: No materially identical transaction for same account, amount, and date window

control_objective: Require standardized active credit reasons.
rule_logic: reason_code exists and is active

control_objective: Require customer contact and documented case support.
rule_logic: case_id and interaction_id are present for customer-initiated credits

control_objective: Protect accounts from unauthorized changes.
rule_logic: authentication_completed_flag = 1 before protected adjustment

control_objective: Require review of manual overrides.
rule_logic: manual_override_flag = 1 requires approved approval

control_objective: Review credits posted outside approved operating hours.
rule_logic: after_hours_flag = 1 requires documented review

control_objective: Detect multiple credits used to avoid approval limits.
rule_logic: Same account, agent, and day credits near authority limit are aggregated

control_objective: Ensure customer promises result in completed action.
rule_logic: promised credit or refund agrees to posted credit

control_objective: Ensure posted credits equal approved amounts.
rule_logic: credit_amount = approved_amount for posted credits

control_objective: Require resolution evidence before closure.
rule_logic: Closed case has resolution_code and resolution_summary

control_objective: Require reversals to link to original transactions.
rule_logic: Reversal references valid original transaction

control_objective: Ensure ledger activity reconciles to closing balance.
rule_logic: opening + charges - payments - credits + reversals = closing

control_objective: Maintain segregation of duties.
rule_logic: agent identity cannot equal approver identity

control_objective: Prevent terminated staff from posting activity.
rule_logic: agent employment_status must be Active on transaction date

control_objective: Ensure transaction customer and account relationships agree.
rule_logic: credit customer_id equals account customer_id

control_objective: Identify unusual credit activity concentrations.
rule_logic: Credit totals and counts exceeding peer thresholds require review

control_objective: Prevent expired or premature promotional credits.
rule_logic: Promotion reason date must fall inside promotion period

control_objective: Require outage support for service credits.
rule_logic: Service-interruption credit requires validated case and supporting documentation
